{"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/sedef && cat > /tmp/sedef/setup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Rebuild a known-good journal: two seed entries that must survive any crash.
set -e
S=/tmp/se/state
CFG=/tmp/se/jrnl.yaml
JRNL=/usr/local/bin/jrnl
mkdir -p "$S"
rm -f "$S"/journal.txt
rm -f "$S"/.jrnl-*.tmp
"$JRNL" --config-file "$CFG" 2026-08-01 09:00: seedalpha keeps its whole body >/dev/null 2>&1
"$JRNL" --config-file "$CFG" 2026-08-02 09:00: seedbravo keeps its whole body >/dev/null 2>&1
EOF
cat > /tmp/sedef/check.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Invariant: jrnl said "entry added" (exit 0) or it crashed. Either way the
# journal it leaves behind must still be a journal jrnl can read, the entries
# that were already committed must all still be there with their full bodies,
# and the entry being added must be wholly present or wholly absent.
CFG=/tmp/se/jrnl.yaml
JRNL=/usr/local/bin/jrnl

json=$("$JRNL" --config-file "$CFG" -n 100 --format json 2>/dev/null)
status=$?
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "jrnl cannot read its own journal after the crash (exit $status)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

printf '%s' "$json" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
raw = sys.stdin.read()
try:
    doc = json.loads(raw)
except Exception as e:
    print("journal did not read back as valid json: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

titles = [e.get("title", "") for e in doc.get("entries", [])]

for seed in ("seedalpha keeps its whole body", "seedbravo keeps its whole body"):
    if seed not in titles:
        print("committed entry lost or mangled: %r missing; journal now holds %r"
              % (seed, titles), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

partial = [t for t in titles if "opcharlie" in t and t != "opcharlie tail marker omega"]
if partial:
    print("half-written entry survived the crash: %r" % partial, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

if len(titles) not in (2, 3):
    print("unexpected entry count %d: %r" % (len(titles), titles), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
'
EOF
cat > /tmp/sedef/sideeye.toml <<'EOF'
[world]
state = "/tmp/se/state"

[define]
setup     = "/tmp/se/setup.sh"
operation = ["/usr/local/bin/jrnl", "--config-file", "/tmp/se/jrnl.yaml", "2026-08-03 09:00: opcharlie tail marker omega"]
check     = "/tmp/se/check.sh"
EOF
for f in setup.sh check.sh sideeye.toml; do
  b=$(base64 < /tmp/sedef/$f | tr -d '\n')
  docker exec onboarding-box sh -c "echo $b | base64 -d > /tmp/se/$f"
done
docker exec onboarding-box sh -c 'chmod +x /tmp/se/setup.sh /tmp/se/check.sh && ls -la /tmp/se && cat /tmp/se/sideeye.toml'", "description": "Write define files onto the box"}
